description: This file contains the implementation of state access functions for the Ansc Atom Table Object, including functions to get counts, get/set table sizes, and reset the table. It is part of a broader system managing atom tables (both integer and string based), and includes function definitions like AnscAtoGetIntAtomCount, AnscAtoGetStrAtomCount, AnscAtoGetIntTableSize, AnscAtoSetIntTableSize, AnscAtoGetStrTableSize, AnscAtoSetStrTableSize, and AnscAtoReset.

methods.name: ULONG AnscAtoGetIntAtomCount(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the count of integer atoms in the table by querying the depth of each linked list in the integer atom table array, protected by a spin lock.

methods.name: ULONG AnscAtoGetStrAtomCount(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the count of string atoms in the table similarly, by summing depths of linked lists in the string atom table array safely under a spin lock.

methods.name: ULONG AnscAtoGetIntTableSize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Returns the size of the integer atom table.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAtoSetIntTableSize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Sets a new size for the integer atom table and reallocates the table accordingly.

methods.name: ULONG AnscAtoGetStrTableSize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Returns the size of the string atom table.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAtoSetStrTableSize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Sets a new size for the string atom table and reallocates the table accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAtoReset(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the atom table object by deleting all string and integer atoms, effectively clearing the tables.
